title: Effectiveness of Brief Intervention in Primary Care for Diverse Young People (Chat)
official: Effectiveness of Brief Intervention in Primary Care for Diverse Young People
summary: Brief motivational interviewing intervention to address alcohol use among diverse teens 12-17.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* receive health care at one of two participating health systems
* aged 12-17
* screen positive for being at risk for alcohol or cannabis use using the CRAFFT

Exclusion Criteria:

* if they don't meet the inclusion criteria, they will be excluded
